$comment: The one statement of who this site is. index.html's Organization and WebSite nodes are the published form of this file; scripts/check-entity-graph.mjs fails the build if the two drift, and scripts/entity-backlink-watch.mjs (.github/workflows/entity-backlink-watch.yml, weekly) refetches every sameAs URL, removes dead ones and promotes pending ones by PR. sameAs lists ONLY third-party profiles that resolve now AND name this site back; anything not yet claimed waits in profiles_pending. Never a URL on this site's own host.
name: HeyGetOnMyLevel
description: AI-powered reading practice for all ages. Free, private, judgment-free literacy.
founder_note: Not applicable: the app speaks as a product, not a person, so no Person node is published.
